title: Alkene Suffix
text: Alkenes (compounds with C=C double bonds) use the suffix '-ene'. The position number indicates where the double bond starts.

title: Lowest Locant Rule
text: Always number from the end that gives the double bond the lowest possible number. If numbered from the left: CH$$_3$$(1)-CH(2)=CH(3)-CH$$_2$$(4)-CH$$_3$$(5), the double bond is at position 2.

title: Final Name
text: Combining pent- (5 carbons) + 2 (position of double bond) + ene (double bond suffix), what is the IUPAC name?
